mostWorthwhile.text: Building the two kinds of sensors was worthwhile: the pictures showed how moving fluid and a weighted layer bend hairs in different situations.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the leftover weighted sensors and inspecting the finished body did not explain why the goal was still open, so that stretch felt frustrating.

surprise.text: The body showed steady eyes and posture adjustments before the goal was complete; the separate nerve-route combination completed it.

arbitrary.text: The final separate combination felt arbitrary because the earlier result already showed the sensors linked through the brain to the outgoing routes. I could not tell why they needed combining again.

continue.text: I might continue because the sensor pictures made unfamiliar balance mechanisms understandable, but the unclear final requirement makes me hesitant.
